title: Smolensk War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Smolensk War", at revision 1371449845, opens: "The Smolensk War (1632–1634) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1140492, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
